newsitem.title: USA: Southwest sets winter fare sale.
newsitem.headline: Southwest sets winter fare sale.

text.p: Southwest Airlines Co on Thursday announced special winter fares on all routes, with prices as low as $29 and no higher than $129 each way.
The fares are available for purchase through December 12 for travel from January 6 through March 6.
Tickets must be purchased within one day of making reservations and are non-refundable, but may be applied toward the purchase of future travel on Southwest if unused, Southwest said.
Seats are limited and may not be available on some flights that operate during peak times and holidays, the airline said.
On Tuesday UAL Corp 's United Airlines and Continental Airlines Inc cut their fares for travel between January 6 through April 30.
United cut its domestic 21-day excursion fares by as much as 50 percent, and Continental cut its fares by up to 40 percent. Tickets must be bought by December 13.
AMR Corp's American Airlines and Delta Air Lines Inc said they had matched the fare cuts.
Trans World Airlines also said it matched the fare cuts on competing markets.
